description: [Free] Reads one provider by the id search_providers returns — costs no credits and returns at least what the search result held: name, address, city, category, Google rating and review count (from nyna’s index, or live from Google Places when the index has none and today’s budget allows), whether the listing is claimed, and — for a claimed listing — the owner’s description, services, website and phone, plus the nyna page. Prices and availability are not held.
name: get_provider

charged.description: credits actually spent; 0 today for every tool
